messages.text: BL-1898 ✅ done — The lander sends QA's bookkeep note as the coordinator, and the close guard accepts only a note from QA, so every lander land's active-to-done commit is refused (BL-1887 landed as feb18315ea and stayed open until QA re-sent by hand); the guard now also accepts the land record the land step writes, for the ticket it names and a commit on main
